machine.name: Hydraulic press
machine.description: A simplified guarded press with a hydraulic power unit, reservoir and ram.

content.text: Original project-authored synthetic reference v1. A simplified guarded press with a hydraulic power unit, reservoir and ram. All numeric values and observations are invented for this educational fixture and must not configure real equipment. Review authorized lockout/tagout and verification of stored-energy isolation before physical access. Use correlated observations and compare competing causes. The authored aeration evidence and suction connection comparison support air ingress. Low pressure by itself could also arise from pressure control, pump delivery or internal leakage.

content.title: An inconsistent press cycle
content.briefing: A press has an inconsistent virtual cycle and noisy pressure response. Review the archived circuit observations and distinguish supply instability from other causes.
hints: Compare at least two independent observations before selecting a diagnosis.
A reading outside its training range is evidence, but does not establish a cause by itself.
steps: Review the simulated safety plan: authorized lockout/tagout, stored-energy isolation and verification before physical access.
Inspect the recorded visual evidence. This simulation does not authorize access to real machinery.
Read the archived condition measurements and compare them with this fixture's training envelope.
Compare the recorded operating history with a competing explanation.
Review the virtual verification evidence, then justify a diagnosis using the strongest observations.

evidence.label: Reservoir observation
evidence.text: Recorded fluid imagery shows aeration during the affected cycle.

evidence.label: Supply comparison
evidence.text: The archived comparison removes a simulated suction connection leak; aeration and pressure instability then disappear.

evidence.label: Temperature record
evidence.text: Fluid temperature remains inside this training fixture's defined operating range.

evidence.label: Service history
evidence.text: The symptom starts after a recorded suction-line service event.

rationale_rubric: 0–10: connects the two distinguishing observations to the proposed cause; partial credit for a supported but incomplete link.
0–10: compares one credible alternative and explains what evidence weakens it; no credit for unsupported certainty.
